Gull's Reach community nonprofit

Neighbors helping neighbors, every season.

Kindred Harbor brings people together to share food, grow gardens, care for the shoreline and make sure no one in town goes without a ride, a coat or a friendly knock on the door.

Volunteer with us See our programs

A harbor is where boats come home. We think a town can be that for people, too.

Kindred Harbor is a small, volunteer-powered organization rooted in the waterfront streets of Gull's Reach. We don't run a big office or a call center. We organize neighbors who already want to help, and we make it easy for them to show up where it matters most.

Kindred Harbor and Gull's Reach are fictional. This website is a design demonstration.

What we do

Five ways neighbors look after each other

Each program is run by a small team of volunteers and shaped by the people it serves.

  • Harbor PantryShared groceries, no questions asked
  • Tidewater GardensShared plots and growing know-how
  • Seed LibraryBorrow seeds, return a few
  • Shoreline KeepersMonthly beach care mornings
  • Lantern RidesLifts to appointments and errands

This winter

Warm Hands Winter Drive

When the wind comes off the water in January, a good coat matters. Every winter our volunteers gather coats, hats and blankets, wash and mend them, and pass them on through the Harbor Pantry shelves.
